attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc service user and inventory-readers group, recursively chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set directories to 750 and files to 640, and verified the original data byte-for-byte via checksums plus a positive read test from a group member. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, triggered a native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the user/group, ownership, permissions, and file checksums all survived the restart intact.
